note: Set B is better because it correctly identifies the 1/2" radius note from the General Sheet Notes, which Set A misses entirely. Set B also correctly interprets the 2" dimensions as top/bottom offsets rather than opening heights (Set A claims 2" height openings, which contradicts the 2-6-2 dimension stack on 10" beams). Set A incorrectly assigns the W8X13 section to 'Floor Beam near Grid 5' (Keynote B1 is W10X15; C1 is W8X13), while Set B correctly identifies W10X15 for the relevant floor beams (D5, B1). Both sets struggle with binding specific dimensions to the correct beam keynotes, but Set B has fewer fundamental misinterpretations of the geometry.
